build_mlp: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable layer sizes, activation, and dropout
create_mlp_with_bias: create an MLP module with custom weight and bias initializers and optional bias
test_mlp_call: test the MLP __call__ method with inputs and is_training flag for dropout
refactor_mlp_reverse: refactor an MLP to produce a reversed layer-wise MLP with inverted output sizes
review_mlp_activate_final: review the MLP activate_final parameter that controls activation on the last layer
